fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: BANK CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA)

fields.name: BUSINESS REPORTING DAY, MONTH & YEAR
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: CARD ACQUIRING/ ISSUING FLAG
fields.description: A flag to indicate whether the details being submitted are for Acquiring or Issuing transactions. [Acquiring = 'ACQ' and Issuing = 'ISS']

fields.name: FRAUD INCIDENT CATEGORY
fields.description: Fraud categorization either "By Instrument" or "By Channel"

fields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF FRAUD INCIDENTS
fields.description: Count on the number of fraud incidents per fraud incident category, card class and category flag

fields.name: VALUE OF FRAUD INCIDENTS IN LCY
fields.payload_key: VALUE OF FRAUD INCIDENT IN LCY
fields.description: Total value of fraud incidents per fraud incident category, card class and category flag
